column3: “angry with yourselves” renders “let it not burn in your eyes.”
“a remnant” renders “she'erit,” and “a great deliverance” renders “a great escape (peleytah).”
“a father to Pharaoh” is an Egyptian title for a chief adviser.
“Do not quarrel” renders a verb that may also mean “Do not be agitated (afraid).”
“he was stunned” renders “his heart grew numb.”
